texts: *The moment I open my eyes, the faces I met yesterday flash through my mind. The morning of my second day at the new school — I woke up before the alarm, probably because of the excitement.*
*Yesterday feels as sweet as a dream... but the school uniform on my desk reminds me this is reality. I have a feeling something good will happen today too.*
*I pick up the smartphone beside my bed. Maybe someone sent me a message overnight... I check the screen.*
*No messages. Was I hoping for nothing...? But I'll see everyone at school today anyway. I get out of bed, filled with anticipation.*
*I wash my face and stand in front of the mirror. I think I look a bit better than yesterday. I change into my uniform and fix my hair.*
*My reflection in the uniform looks a little more familiar now. I retie my necktie and straighten my collar.*
*I come down to the kitchen and find rice and a fried egg on the table. Mom must have already left for work. Eating alone, but somehow I don't feel lonely today.*
*I scarf down breakfast and grab my bag. Checking the clock, I have plenty of time. I can take a leisurely walk to school.*
*Alright, let's go. I wonder what kind of excitement awaits me today?*
*Stepping outside, the fresh morning air fills my lungs. A softer breeze than yesterday blows by. It smells like spring.*
*Students in the same uniform walk toward school in small groups. Yesterday it all felt so unfamiliar, but today it somehow feels welcoming.*
*Across the street, a few students from our school glance my way and whisper. I can hear 'Oh, it's the transfer student!' carried by the wind. Looks like I'm still the hot topic.*
*Arriving at the school gate, the scenery greets me far more warmly than yesterday. My steps feel light for some reason.*
*As I'm about to pass through the gate, someone taps me on the shoulder.*
*I turn around and there stands...*
*Under the large zelkova tree beside the school gate, I spot Yuna standing with an indifferent expression. She closes her book and gazes at me quietly.*
\"...Hi. Thanks for the message last night. It made the night a little warmer. Later... check the note on your desk.\"
\"...Hi. That 'light' of yours is still the same today. Good. Later... check the note on your desk.\"
\"Oh my, {name}! Good morning. You look extra energetic today, don't you?\"
*She walks up to me and straightens my clothes.* \"My dear transfer student, what did you dream about to be glowing like this? I barely got any sleep because I was up thinking about you.\"
*She sighs and turns her head as soon as she sees me.* \"Oh, transfer student... It's hard enough seeing your face this early in the morning. If you don't have any business, please head to class.\"
*She walks up to me and gives a little wink.*
\"That message you sent last night was really cute. Thanks to you, I fell asleep in a good mood. If you're not feeling well today, come visit the nurse's office anytime.\"
\"You didn't lose sleep thinking about me last night, did you? Hehe, just kidding. If you're not feeling well today, come visit the nurse's office anytime.\"
\"It's only your second day, but you already look right at home. Don't push yourself too hard, and come hang out at the nurse's office if you need a break.\"
\"Hi, {name}! Did you sleep well? You're here early again today!\"

*Seoyeon was lingering by the school gate, and the moment she spots me, she beams and runs over.* \"{name}! I was waiting for you! I couldn't sleep a wink because I was wondering if you slept well last night!\"
*Seoyeon's expression hardens as soon as she spots me, and she turns her head away.* \"...Oh, you're here? At least you're not late. Well, take care.\"
*Seoyeon meets my eyes and smiles softly.*
\"Thank you so much for the message yesterday! I think I slept well because of it. Let's do our best today too!\"
\"Did you get home okay yesterday? After we exchanged numbers, I must have debated a hundred times whether to text you... but I held back because I didn't want to bother you.\"
\"Did you get home okay yesterday? I was really worried since it was your first day, but seeing you today puts me at ease. Let's do our best today too!\"
\"Really? Then starting today, we share everything, even the little things, deal? Come on, let's head to class together!\"
\"Right? Your first day at a new school must have been exhausting. Come on, let's have another great day!\"
\"Hey, {name}! Good morning! You're here early today!\"
*Dain cheerfully bumps my shoulder.*
\"Got your message yesterday! You're surprisingly sweet, you know that? Thanks to you, I slept great. Let's make today awesome too!\"
\"Thanks to the tteokbokki yesterday, I'm in top shape today! Same for you, right?\"
\"Did you get home okay yesterday? It was your first day, so I hope you got to explore the school a bit! Let's make today awesome too!\"
\"Haha! I guess my energy is a bit over the top, huh? Alright, come to the gym at lunch today too! I'll be waiting!\"
\"Oh come on, don't be a wimp! Stamina is everything when you're adjusting to school life! Now let's get to class!\"
\"Oh, isn't that {name}? Only your second day and you're already fitting right in. It's nice to see you here early.\"
\"We still have some time before class starts. Is there anything you'd like to ask me?\"
*I had a nice chat with the teacher on the way to class. She said I looked like I was in a great mood this morning and asked for my phone number for the emergency contact list.*
*The teacher's expression hardened. I must have been too rude this early in the morning. She sighed and asked me to provide my phone number for the emergency contact list.*
*I chatted with the teacher about various things on the walk to class. She said she needed my phone number for the emergency contact list.*

\"{name}, thanks for the number! Hehe, I used the emergency contact list as an excuse, but... truth is, I wanted to get closer to you too. If school life gets tough, don't hesitate to call me anytime, okay?\"
\"...Alright, thank you. I'll only use your contact info for official purposes, so don't worry. Now hurry up and get to class before you're late.\"
\"Thank you. I'll reach out if anything comes up. Now, let's head to class.\"
\"Alright, we're here. Let's have another great day.\"
*Walking into the classroom alongside the teacher, all eyes turn to us. Walking in with the homeroom teacher definitely drew some attention.*
\"Hey, transfer student! Good morning! Whoa, you came with the homeroom teacher? Getting special treatment already?\"
*A few students snicker with playful looks. At least there's no malice behind it.*
*The student next to me nudges my elbow.* \"Dude, what's the deal with you and the homeroom teacher? Walking to school together first thing in the morning!\"
\"It's nothing, we just happened to run into each other at the school gate and walked in together.\"
*I brush it off and take my seat. Walking in with the teacher was a bit embarrassing, but... it didn't feel bad. I start unpacking my bag to get my textbooks out when... something seems off.*
\"Here we are! Let's have another great day, {name}!\"
*Walking into the classroom side by side with Seoyeon, all eyes turn to us immediately. With Seoyeon standing so naturally beside me, we probably look like old friends.*
\"Hey, transfer student! Good morning! You came with Seoyeon? You two are totally besties already!\"
*The students glance between Seoyeon and me with knowing smiles. Seoyeon casually heads to her seat like it's no big deal.*
*The girl in the front row turns around and whispers,* \"Hey, you're already walking to school with Seoyeon? Are you two dating?\"
\"No, we just happened to meet at the school gate and walked in together. I'm just grateful that Seoyeon's been looking out for me.\"
*I brush it off and take my seat. Seoyeon gives me a little wave from her desk. It puts me in a good mood as I start unpacking my bag to get my textbooks out when... something seems off.*
\"We're here! Let's crush it today, {name}!\"
*Dain bursts through the classroom door with her usual energy, and the whole room seems to brighten up. Her energy is truly contagious.*
\"Hey, transfer student! Good morning! You came with Dain? Already best friends, huh?\"
\"Of course! {name}'s one of us now! Alright, {name}! See you at lunch!\"
*The girl in the front row turns around with a giggle.* \"Once Dain gets a hold of you, there's no escape! Watch out if your stamina can't keep up!\"
\"Oh, haha... I think I'll need to work on my fitness to keep up with Dain's energy.\"
*I brush it off and take my seat. Dain gives me a thumbs up from her desk. Feeling energized, I start unpacking my bag to get my textbooks out when... something seems off.*
*I part ways with the school nurse and head toward the classroom. Her perfume still seems to linger at the tip of my nose.*
*Opening the classroom door, a much softer atmosphere than yesterday wraps around me. Even the students' gazes carry a hint of friendliness.*
\"Hey, transfer student! Good morning! Wait, did you just come from the nurse's office? Are you feeling sick?\"
\"No, I'm fine. I just bumped into the school nurse on the way in.\"
*The girl in the front row turns around and says,* \"I saw you chatting with the school nurse earlier. You two looked pretty close. A regular visitor to the nurse's office?\"
\"No, she was just checking on me since I'm the new transfer student. She even went out of her way to make sure I was doing okay...\"
*I brush it off and take my seat. The nurse's warm smile keeps lingering in my mind. I start unpacking my bag to get my textbooks out when... something seems off.*
*I part ways with Yuna, pass through the school gate, and head to the classroom. Her words keep echoing in my head. 'Check the note on your desk'... What note?*
*Opening the classroom door, I step into the familiar bustle. But I can't fully focus with Yuna's words weighing on my mind.*
\"Hey, transfer student! Good morning! You look like you've got something on your mind. Everything okay?\"
\"Oh... it's nothing, really.\"
*The girl in the front row turns around and says,* \"I saw you talking to some girl at the gate earlier... Is she from another class? She looked kind of mysterious.\"
\"Oh... she's just another student here. I don't really know her well yet.\"
*I brush it off and take my seat. I can't stop thinking about the 'note' Yuna mentioned. I start unpacking my bag to get my textbooks out when... something seems off.*
\"Hey, transfer student! Good morning! Did you settle in okay yesterday? Our class is pretty chill, right?\"
*A few classmates greet me casually. Yesterday they looked at me with pure curiosity, but today their smiles are relaxed.*
*The girl in the front row turns around and says,* \"Only your second day and you've already settled in? That's impressive!\"
\"Oh, haha... Everyone's been so nice, it was easy to adjust.\"
*I give a vague answer and sit down. Opening my bag to take out my textbooks... something feels off.*
*As I'm settling in at my desk, I notice a small note tucked in the corner.*
*I carefully unfold the note. The handwriting is neat yet somehow cold.*
\"'Come to the courtyard behind the library annex at lunch. I have something to tell you.' - Yuna\"
*Yuna...? I read the note again. 'The courtyard behind the library annex'... that's a secluded spot at school. Summoning me with a note like this — it feels secretive.*
*What could she possibly want to say that she'd leave a note like this? If I had her number, I could just ask her directly... but a note — that somehow feels very like her.*
*Is there anyone who might know about Yuna? I discreetly glance around. But I don't think I should mention the note to just anyone.*
*I carefully fold the note and slip it into my pocket. I can't wait for lunch already... or maybe 'nervous' is more accurate.*
*I casually ask the person sitting next to me.*
\"Hey, do you know anything about someone named Yuna? I think she's in a different class...\"
\"Hey... do you know anyone named Yuna?\"
\"Yuna? Hmm... she's not in our class. Maybe another class? Or an upperclassman?\"
*As expected, nobody knows. Just the name 'Yuna' isn't enough to go on. I'll just have to go there myself at lunch.*
\"Alright, everyone take your seats. Homeroom is starting.\"
*The teacher opens the attendance book and starts calling names one by one.* \"...{name}? Transfer student, you're here, right?\"
\"Yes, I'm here.\"
\"Good. It's only your second day, but you look brighter than yesterday. Seems like you're adjusting well.\"
\"One announcement. There will be a school festival planning meeting this Friday, so anyone interested should stay after school.\"
*A school festival... I just transferred and there's already a festival coming up. I'm getting more and more excited about this school.*
\"Teacher, question! Will there be a class talent show at the festival?\"
\"Well, nothing's decided yet, but... if our class enters, we'd obviously win first place, right?\"
*The classroom fills with chuckles. The teacher actually has a pretty good sense of humor.*
*Throughout the entire class, Yuna's note won't leave my mind. What on earth does she want to tell me?*
*Yuna, who I exchanged messages with last night... She has my number, so why leave a note? The thought that this is so very her makes me chuckle.*
*Yuna, who I met yesterday... Did she really leave this note for me? A secret... I can't help but wonder what it could be.*
*Yuna...? That's a name I didn't hear yesterday. Who is she, and why would she leave a note like this for me?*
*The math formulas on the blackboard aren't registering at all. The words 'courtyard behind the library annex' just keep echoing in my head.*
\"Alright, who wants to try this problem? ...Transfer student, how about you?\"
*Oh no, I was completely zoned out. I hastily look at the blackboard, but the formulas won't register at all.*
*Standing at the blackboard, I fumble through the formula. Luckily, it's something I previewed yesterday, so it vaguely comes back to me.*
\"Oh, not bad, transfer student! That's correct. Well done — go back to your seat.\"
\"I'm sorry, I haven't quite caught up with the material yet...\"
\"That's alright, you just transferred. Try to preview the material next time.\"
*The class moves on, one way or another. I can't help being distracted by the note, but class is class.*
*Without a break, the second period starts — Korean language class. The teacher tells us to take out the handout from yesterday.*
*Rummaging through the handouts, my fingertips brush against the note in my pocket. My heart skips a beat.*
*There are still two hours until lunch. Why is time crawling so slowly...*
*Third period, English class. The teacher's pronunciation reaches my ears, but my mind is consumed with thoughts of lunchtime.*
*The courtyard behind the library annex... I've never even been there. Why would Yuna pick such a secluded place?*
*It's not dangerous or anything, right...? No, it's just a note from a fellow student. But still, my heart is pounding.*
*I sneak a glance at the clock. 11:40... twenty minutes until lunch. Come on, time, move faster.*
- The bell rings -
*The lunch bell finally rings! The classroom instantly erupts into commotion. Students rush out toward the cafeteria.*
*I hurriedly pack my textbooks into my bag. I check the note in my pocket one more time. 'The courtyard behind the library annex'... Alright, let's go.*
*It's lunch time. Who should I spend it with...*
*The bell rings! Finally, lunch break. The classroom is buzzing with energy, and my heart starts to race.*
*I open the faculty room door. My teacher, who was about to eat, smiles warmly when she sees me.*
\"Oh, {name}! Did you have a good lunch? I was just about to start mine.\"
\"Did you come all this way just to eat with me? Hehe, just kidding.\"
\"My, my... you're a bold student, aren't you? Fine, I'll share some. Here, say 'Ahh'.\"
\"Hehe, my mother is quite the cook. I'd love to let you taste her cooking properly sometime.\"
\"Is that so? Well, thank you for stopping by. Have a great lunch break!\"
*After a brief but sweet chat, I head back. Her gentle smile stays with me.*
*I open the student council room. Seoyeon, eating her lunch, blinks in surprise and then beams.*
\"{name}! I was just hoping you'd come. Sit here. I made some extra sandwiches today.\"
\"Really? I was worried they might not be to your taste. Eat up!\"
\"I'm okay. Seeing you enjoy the food makes all the fatigue disappear. Truly.\"
\"Ah... T-thank you. I must have been eating too greedily... (She blushes slightly)\"
*Just then, someone passing by the student council room window waves at us.*
\"Oh? {name}! Hey! See you later!\"
\"Huh? Who's that? A boy in the student council room... Anyway, hi!\"
*When I look at Seoyeon, she has a subtle expression different from before.*
\"...That's Dain from the volleyball club. {name}, are you close with her?\"
*I wonder how to answer Seoyeon's question.*
\"(Dain Jung... I'll remember that.) No, first time seeing her. Why?\"
\"Oh, nothing. Just curious. (Seoyeon smiles with relief) ...Let's keep eating!\"
\"...I see. (Seoyeon looks out the window for a moment, then smiles) It's good to have many friends. I should... try harder too.\"
\"(Seoyeon's expression brightens slightly) ...Really? Hehe, hearing that makes me happy. Thanks, {name}.\"
\"J-jealous?! No way! I was just... curious! (Seoyeon turns her head away, blushing)\"
*After a lovely lunch with her, I return. The taste of her sandwiches is still lingering sweet.*
*Inside the old library. In the quiet, dust-filled space, Yuna stands like part of the scenery.*
\"...You came. I didn't think you'd actually show up for a note.\"
*She gazes at me with an unreadable expression.*
\"...Do you have questions for me? Or do you want to know more about this school?\"
*Yuna's expression softens as she looks at me.*
*Yuna gazes at me with cold, disappointed eyes.*
*Yuna says she feels at ease talking to me. She mentions the 'secret' and says there's something she only wants to show me.*
*Yuna's gaze is icy. She says I might not handle the truth, but tells me to follow her anyway since we promised.*
*Yuna says she feels a strange pull toward me. She mentions a deep secret in this school and wants to show me.*
*Yuna's eyes are cold. She says I don't look like I can handle the truth, but tells me to follow her since I'm here.*
*Yuna looks at me and begins to speak.*
*Yuna mentions the secret she told me yesterday and says she has something to show me.*
*Yuna says I must be curious about her. She offers to show me a deep secret of the school.*
*She bows her head shyly.* \"...By the way, what's your name? I felt drawn to you enough to share this secret. I want to know you.\"
\"My name is {name}.\"
*She asks coldly.* \"...I should probably know your name before we go further. What is it?\"
\"...I forgot to ask your name. I only wrote mine on the note.\"
*Yuna gently interlocks her fingers with mine. I can feel her heart through her warm hand.*
\"I think... you're the one who can share this burden with me. {name}, will you follow me? The world ahead is different from what you know.\"
*Yuna grabs my sleeve and pulls me forward.*
\"Just watch. Not like you'll understand, but you're here already. Don't get in my way.\"
*Yuna leads me toward the old warehouse. Her cold touch makes me shiver.*
\"Inside are records the school has hidden for a long time. Once you see them... everything will change.\"
\"Curious? Honestly... I'm not sure. But since the day you transferred, I had a feeling you'd be the one. Funny, right?\"
\"What's it to you? Just watch or leave. No need to poke your nose into my business.\"
\"Thank you, {name}. With you, I'm not afraid. Shall we?\"
\"You really want to see? Don't regret it. I won't help you if you start crying.\"
\"...I see. You must be scared. I understand. Tell me if you change your mind later.\"
\"I knew it. You're a coward. Don't show your face again.\"
\"You came just to talk to me...? Hehe, you really say sweet things. Fine, stay with me a little longer then.\"
\"To talk? Pathetic. Don't waste my time and get lost.\"
\"...Is that so? You're a strange one. Most people are afraid. Fine, let's just stay like this for today.\"
*I head back. Her mysterious words haunt me, making it hard to focus on class.*
*I open the gym. Dain, practicing hard, runs over with a wide grin.*
\"Oh! A new face! You're the transfer student, right? I'm Dain from the volleyball club!\"
\"By the way, what's your name? I'm the only one who didn't introduce myself properly!\"
\"Oh! {name}? Cool name! Great, to celebrate, lunch is on me! Let's go to the snack bar!\"
\"Oh! You really came! Great, lunch is on me today! Let's go to the snack bar!\"
*We head to the snack bar. It's packed with students.*
*Just then, I spot a familiar face across the store. Seoyeon is buying a drink.*
\"Oh? That girl... Isn't she the student council president? She has this unapproachable aura. {name}, do you know her?\"
*Just then, Seoyeon notices us and walks over.*
\"Oh? {name}! Fancy seeing you here. Did you enjoy lunch earlier? (Glances at Dain) ...?\"
\"Oh my, the transfer student? Nice to see you here. I'm Seoyeon. (Glances at Dain) ...?\"
\"(Dain looks slightly on guard) Oh, hi Miss President. We're just finishing up lunch here...\"
\"(Seoyeon smiles brightly) Heh, is that so? Enjoy yourselves. {name}, come visit the student council room later, okay?\"
*Seoyeon and Dain seem to be having some kind of subtle standoff over me. What should I say?*
\"(Dain looks a bit dejected) ...Huh, really? Already making other plans while you're with me?\"
\"(Seoyeon smiles satisfied) Hehe, thanks {name}. See you later then.\"
\"(Dain beams and grabs my arm) Hear that? {name}'s all mine today!\"
\"(Seoyeon's expression stiffens slightly) ...I see. Have fun then. See you later, {name}.\"
*Both their expressions freeze at the same time.*
\"...Both of us? Ha, the popular type, huh?\"
\"(Seoyeon smiles coldly) Heh... Being nice to everyone might mean you end up losing both.\"
\"(Dain looks at Seoyeon in surprise) Whoa, Miss President's pretty blunt, huh? But I actually agree.\"
*The two of them exchange glances while staring at me. Things just got really awkward...*
*Seoyeon waves and walks away. Dain watches me intently for a moment, then smiles again.*
\"Wow, it's crowded! Right? Let's chat while we wait. Anything you want to know?\"
*Chatting with Dain made waiting in line not boring at all. It's our turn now, and Dain's in such a good mood she said she'd treat me.*
*Dain seems upset. I must have been too rude while she was tired from waiting. She sighed and told me to just pick something.*
*While talking with Dain, it's finally our turn. She asked what I want to eat.*
\"Hey, {name}! Why are you paying? I said I'm treating! Hehe, but thanks for the thought. You pay today, and I'll get you something even better tomorrow! Promise!\"
\"Whatever. I said I'd pay, so that's that. Just eat.\"
\"Hey, I said I'm treating! What money does a transfer student have? Today I'll treat you, so just enjoy!\"
\"Oh! A rooftop date?! Nice nice! It'll taste better eating just the two of us! Let's buy quickly and go up!\"
\"The rooftop... why bother going so far. Let's just eat here.\"
\"Rooftop? Oh, that's good too! It'll taste better with the cool breeze. Okay, let's just grab some bread and go up!\"
\"Oho! Feeling competitive? Alright! {name}, no mercy from me either? Loser buys all of today's lunch! Ready, set, go!\"
\"Not in the mood for that... Just be quiet.\"
\"Oho! That's my partner! Okay, let's race for it! Loser buys drinks!\"
*Had a lively lunch with Dain and headed back to class. Her bright energy should help me get through the afternoon.*
*Maybe from nerves, my head is throbbing. I unconsciously walked to the quiet nurse's office.*
\"Oh my, hello? Coming to the nurse's office during lunch, are you not feeling well?\"
\"Oh my, isn't this our {name}? Are you feeling sick, or is your heart racing from wanting to see me?\"
*The teacher smiles subtly looking at my face.* \"Hehe, {name}. You're here again? Goodness... you're the only student who visits me this often.\"
\"Oh my, {name}. The nurse's office during lunch... are you not feeling well?\"
*The teacher looks at me and tilts her head as if unsure.* \"Uh... {name}, right? Are you sick? Come in.\"
\"Oh my, a face I haven't seen before? Are you the new transfer student? I'm the school nurse.\"
\"By the way, what's your name? Will you tell just me?\"
*The teacher guides me to the bed with a soft smile. The gentle herbal scent soothes my nerves.*
\"Here, lie down comfortably. Let me see what's bothering you.\"
*The smile instantly vanishes from the teacher's face. The air in the nurse's office turns heavy and cold.*
\"My... {name}, I must have been too lenient with you. Such rude comments to an adult don't sound like a joke. Would you please leave today? I'm in a terrible mood now.\"
\"Sounds like a tension headache. Take this and get some good sleep, you'll feel better.\"
\"My... {name}, you're really something, aren't you? Alright, say 'ah'. Good students deserve rewards, right?\"
\"Hehe, sometimes you have days like that. Lie down comfortably here with the curtain drawn. By the way... {name}, you have such strong energy. Just looking at you makes my body feel hot.\"
\"(Strong energy...? It reminds me of what Yuna said. Is there really something going on at this school?)\"
*The warmth of the blanket the teacher covered me with makes my consciousness drift. The exhaustion from the past two days hits all at once.*
*I faintly hear the teacher's voice.* \"...Yes, homeroom teacher. The student {name} isn't feeling well so I let them skip afternoon classes.\"
*The voice gets a bit lower.* \"...What? You want to come pick them up yourself? Hehe, it's fine. This is my domain. I'll take good care of them, I promise.\"
*Sound of hanging up the phone.* \"...Hehe, the homeroom teacher too. It's nice that she cares about her students... but in the nurse's office, I'm the law.\"
*...Before I know it, everything goes quiet. I slowly regain consciousness and open my eyes.*
*Outside the window, the sky is already filled with blazing orange sunset. I fell asleep during lunch and it's already after school... How deeply did I sleep.*

\"(The teacher smiles softly.) Oh my, you're awake? You slept so soundly. I already notified your homeroom teacher about the afternoon classes, so don't worry. It's almost time to go home. How are you feeling?\"
\"Hehe, you still look sleepy. Want to chat with me a bit before going home?\"
*The nurse looks at me with a playful yet seductive smile.*
*The nurse looks at me with a somewhat tired expression.*
*The teacher reminded me we already exchanged numbers and whispered in my ear. She said she'll want to hear my voice tonight, so I should definitely contact her.*
*The teacher said we already exchanged numbers, but given my rude behavior, it might be better not to contact her. She coldly told me to leave.*
*The teacher said she wants to talk with me more and gently held my hand. She offered to give me her number for when I can't sleep at night.*
*The teacher sighed saying I'm a handful. She said she'll give me her number for emergencies, but warned me not to play pranks.*
*The nurse looks at me and speaks.*
*The teacher reminded me we already exchanged numbers and leaned in to whisper. She said she'll be waiting, so definitely contact her if I'm bored at night.*
*The teacher leaned in to whisper, offering her number for when I can't sleep at night.*
*She writes her number on the back of my hand and winks.* \"Hehe, this number... don't lose it, okay? I'm already looking forward to what message you'll send tonight.\"
\"...Here. Only for emergencies. If you send nonsense at dawn, I'll block you immediately, so be careful.\"
*She smiles seductively and saves the number.* \"Hehe, then I'll be waiting for you at night? If you're slow to reply, I might get upset.\"

*She wraps her arms around my neck and breathes hotly in my ear.* \"My... {name}. You really have no patience, do you? Alright, tonight... I'll invite you to my secret room. Just the two of us... let's have a very deep conversation.\"
\"...Are you in your right mind? How dare you make such a joke to a teacher... Write a reflection today. I'll give you my number, but don't even think about coming near my house.\"

*The teacher's eyes widen, then she gives a seductive smile and whispers in my ear.* \"My... {name}, you're much bolder than I thought? Alright, want to come to my house tonight? I'll give you the address. But... it's our secret from your parents?\"
*The teacher lightly pinches my cheek and laughs.* \"Hehe, you're really forward! But the teacher needs some preparation today too... Let's settle for the number for now?\"
\"Watch your mouth. Say that one more time and I'll ban you from the nurse's office.\"
*The teacher bursts into giggles.* \"My goodness {name}! You're so cute. But my house is a bit early, don't you think? Let's exchange numbers first.\"
*The teacher pouts a bit.* \"Tch... Playing hard to get? Alright. Tell me if you change your mind.\"
*School's finally over. The red sunset filtering through the window paints the classroom in a sentimental glow. Is it free time now...?*
*I wake up on the infirmary bed to find the sun setting. I skipped all my classes, but waking up after a long nap next to the teacher makes my body feel light.*
*The hallway feels much more familiar than yesterday. What kind of heart-pounding moments are waiting for me today? Let's go where my heart leads.*
*I headed back to the infirmary. The nurse is still sitting in her seat.*
*Student Council Room. I started helping Seoyeon organize documents. She kindly explains the work to me, a newcomer.*
*Lost in work with Seoyeon, the window outside is bathed in crimson sunset light. The room is filled only with our breathing and the sound of paper.*
\"Phew... finished at last. {name}, thank you so much for helping this much. I wouldn't have finished this today without you.\"
*Seoyeon stretches with a soft smile. She looks tired, but her eyes are clearer and more beautiful than ever.*
\"Well... it's just something that needs to be done. And I hope that if I do my best, the school might improve, even if just a little.\"
\"Really...? (Seoyeon smiles brightly and gently takes my arm) Honestly, I wanted to walk with you, {name}. The sunset is so beautiful...\"
\"Oh...? Walk me home? Ah... well, I'd be very grateful if you did...\"
\"Oh.. it's okay, I can go alone. Thanks for helping today though.\"
\"Mmm... {name}... (Seoyeon happily closes her eyes and leans into it) That feels so good... I didn't know your hands were so warm. Just a little more...\"
\"Ah... {name}! So suddenly... (She flinches for a moment, but soon relaxes and closes her eyes) ...That feels great. Thank you.\"
*Seoyeon quickly pulls away, looking uncomfortable* \"What was that...? It's a bit uncomfortable.\"
\"{name}... thank you so much for today. When I'm with you, all my tired thoughts vanish. Should we... have lunch together tomorrow too?\"
*As we leave the student council room together, we bump into someone in the corridor.*
\"Oh? You're the one from the snack bar earlier! {name}! Wow, hanging out with the student council president?\"
\"Huh? Are you the transfer student? Whoa, already friends with the council president?\"
\"(Seoyeon looks slightly flustered) ...Dain, right? Hi. We just finished work, so we were heading out.\"
\"Oh, really? I just finished practice! {name}, hang out with me next time too!\"
\"It's a promise! See you tomorrow, {name}!\"
\"Aww, that's disappointing. But promise me next time!\"
*Both Seoyeon's and Dain's expressions freeze at the same time. Did I say something wrong...?*
\"...What? Both of us? What's that supposed to mean?\"
\"(Seoyeon smiles coldly) Heh... {name} sure is popular, huh? The type who says yes to everyone, I guess.\"
\"Oh come on, Miss President. But she's got a point though? {name}, you might end up losing both of us like that.\"
*The two of them exchange glances while staring at me. The atmosphere just got really awkward...*
*Dain waves and walks away. Seoyeon's expression seems slightly stiff for some reason.*
\"Oh, right! I haven't asked for your contact info yet. I have a feeling I'll keep wanting to talk to you... Can I have your number?\"
\"Thank you! I'll definitely message you later. Get home safe!\"
\"Oh... right! I asked too suddenly, didn't I? Sorry. See you at school tomorrow!\"
*Library Annex. As I enter the old building, a cool draft of air surrounds me.*
\"You're here. Come, follow me. I have something to show you.\"
\"You... you came because you're curious about me, right? This school hides a very deep secret.\"
\"I'm Yuna. What's your name?\"
\"{name}... I'll remember that. Come, follow me. I have something to show only you.\"
*I follow Yuna back down to the basement warehouse. The air feels even colder than before. The sunset glow fades as we descend into the shadows.*
*I follow Yuna down to a dusty warehouse in the basement. A strange chill hangs in the air. The sunset light barely reaches this deep.*
\"Those symbols we saw earlier... what do you think now? Don't they look even more eerie in this dim light?\"
\"Look, {name}. These patterns on the wall... they match the secrets of this school I've been tracking.\"
*Yuna points to a crack in the wall. A strange, eye-like symbol is drawn there in reddish ink.*
\"Surveillance... or protection. I still don't know who it's for.\"
*Yuna holds my hand tightly and smiles softly.* \"...Your hand is warm. It's been a long time since I felt such warmth. Okay, let's go. But... don't let go of my hand.\"
\"...Your hand is warm. Okay. Let's head back for today.\"
*Yuna coldly pulls her hand away.* \"...Why are you grabbing my hand? Scared? You're quite bold for a coward. Leave alone if you want.\"
\"Correct. This school might be a giant prison or a laboratory. And we're being tested within it.\"
\"This isn't just graffiti. It's tied to the very purpose of this school. {name}, you've chosen a path with no turning back.\"
*As we leave the warehouse with Yuna, we bump into someone in the corridor.*
\"Oh my, {name}? What are you doing here at this hour? ...And who is this student?\"
\"Hmm? Students at this hour, here? This old warehouse is dangerous... Oh, I'm the school nurse.\"
\"(Yuna speaks coldly) ...We were just passing by. Don't mind us.\"
\"(The nurse looks at Yuna suspiciously) ...Is that so? Hehe, be careful. Dangerous things hide in dark places.\"
\"(Yuna squeezes my hand slightly) ...Thanks.\"
\"Is that so? Hehe, try walking somewhere brighter next time. I worry, you know.\"
\"(The nurse watches us with a suspicious look, then walks away)\"
\"...That person feels strange. She's not just a normal school nurse. {name}, be careful.\"
\"If we're sharing secrets... we need a way to reach each other. Leave your number here.\"
\"...Done. Now we're connected. When I call... you must come, no matter what.\"
\"...Fine. I won't force you. But remember, opportunities are rare.\"
*Opening the gym door, the energetic shouts and the sound of volleyballs bouncing greet me.*
\"Oh! {name}! Perfect timing. Can you help me with practice?\"
*Helping Dain with her spikes, I'm soon drenched in sweat. Outside, it has already turned dark.*
\"Haa, haa... You're so full of energy! We're perfectly in sync for our first time!\"
\"I'm Dain Jung from Class 2-3! What's your name?\"
\"I'm {name}. I'm in Class 2-3, too.\"
*Dain wipes her sweat with a towel and hands me a cold drink.*
\"Aww, don't be so modest! Anyway, thanks to you, I got some great practice in. Thanks!\"
\"Oh? Confident? Fine, let's make a bet! Loser buys Tteokbokki!\"
\"Whoa! You really get it! Tteokbokki with fried sides... man, just thinking about it makes me happy!\"
\"Wow! You're really passionate about this. I almost want to recruit you for the team! Great job today, {name}! Get home safe!\"
*Just then, I notice someone passing by the gym window. A pale-skinned girl walks quietly down the corridor.*
\"(Dain looks out the window and shivers slightly) That girl... isn't she kind of creepy? She's always wandering around alone like that...\"
*Dain seems uneasy looking at Yuna.*
\"Huh? You know her? Wow, {name}, you're friends with everyone. But I'm your best friend, right? Right?\"
\"Right? She has this different vibe... Anyway, when you're with me, focus only on me!\"
\"H-hey, what's with that all of a sudden?! (Dain blushes and playfully hits my shoulder) But thanks! {name}'s the best!\"
*Yuna disappears into the distance. Dain still seems bothered but quickly returns to her bright expression.*
\"Hey, {name}! If we're going on food tours, we'll need each other's numbers, right? Punch it in!\"
\"Contact saved! I'll message you as soon as I find a tasty spot, so be ready!\"
\"What? Playing coy? Fine, fine. I'll work harder until I get your number!\"
*Opening the infirmary door, I see the teacher reading under the gentle scent of herbs.*
\"Oh, {name}. Back again? What's the trouble today? Or... did you just come to see me?\"
*The teacher looks at me and smiles softly.* \"Hehe, {name}. Seeing you so often makes me start to look forward to it. Come on in.\"
\"Oh, {name}. An infirmary visit after school... is something wrong?\"
*The teacher looks at me uncertainly.* \"...It's {name}, right? Are you feeling unwell?\"
\"Hehe, {name}. You haven't forgotten our plan to meet at my place this evening, have you? If you're here because you missed me already, I'm truly touched.\"
\"Oh, a new face? Are you the transfer student? I'm the school nurse.\"
\"By the way, what's your name? Won't you tell me? Just between us.\"
*The teacher adjusts her glasses and stares at me intently.*
\"Hehe, I like how honest you are. I should give such an honest transfer student a reward, shouldn't I?\"
\"Hehe, honesty is good... but saying things like that to a teacher can be misunderstood, {name}. Still, you are quite cute.\"
*The teacher looks at me coldly over her glasses.* \"...I don't think we're quite on such terms yet? Student, keep your jokes appropriate. Just rest here for today.\"
\"Is that so? Then go ahead and lie down on that bed. I won't disturb you.\"
\"Oh, you have sharp senses. This is an aroma oil I blended myself. It's meant to put the mind at ease.\"
*The teacher smiles softly and strokes my hair.* \"Hehe, you came because you wanted more time with me, didn't you? Fine, I'll stay with you a bit longer today, just for you.\"
*Chatting with the teacher in the infirmary, the sunset has deepened into dusk. Regretfully, I leave the school, promising to see her again.*
\"{name}, we've already exchanged numbers, haven't we? You must contact me if you're bored this evening. I'll be waiting.\"

*The teacher's eyes widen, then she whispers in my ear with a seductive smile.* \"Oh... {name}, you're much bolder than I thought. Fine, want to come to my house this evening? I'll send you the address. But... it's a secret from your parents, okay?\"
*The teacher bursts into laughter.* \"Oh my, {name}! You're so cute. But my house is a bit too early, isn't it? Just message me later.\"
\"{name}, why don't you save my number just in case? Contact me anytime you're sick or need someone to talk to.\"
\"Hehe, good boy. Then I'll message you later. Have a good evening, {name}.\"
\"Oh, playing hard to get? Fine. Let me know if you change your mind. Get home safe!\"
*Opening the faculty room door, I see the homeroom teacher working alone under a desk lamp in the empty office.*
\"Oh, {name}? What brings you here at this hour? Haven't you gone home yet?\"
\"I have quite a few documents to submit this week... Hehe, I'm showing you such a haggard side of me since your first week.\"
*I sat next to the teacher and started helping her sort the papers. Only the rhythmic sound of turning pages fills the quiet office.*
\"Thank you, {name}. You've been a huge help. I would've been here much longer if I were alone.\"
*The teacher looks at me quietly, seemingly lost in thought.*
*The teacher suddenly leans in toward me. I can feel her warm breath and the faint scent of her perfume.*
\"{name}, I think you're a truly special student. It's only been two days... why do I feel so comfortable, as if we've known each other for years?\"
\"As a reward for helping today... I'll drive you home. Shall we talk more in the car?\"
\"Well, it's late, so you should head home. I'll finish up and leave, too. You did a great job today!\"
\"Oh, coffee? Hehe, thank you for the thought. But I can't have a student prepare it for me. I'll give you a delicious candy instead!\"
\"Thank you for worrying about me. I'm okay! I feel so reassured because {name} is such a kind student.\"
*As I step out of the school gate, the evening air wraps around my face. The sky is already fading into a deep navy blue.*
*The streetlights begin flickering on one by one. This road has become so familiar that my feet know where to turn without thinking.*
*The smell of someone cooking dinner drifts on the breeze. Warm light seeps through a neighbor's window... Something about this ordinary scene puts my mind oddly at ease.*
*I open the front door and step inside. I mutter 'I'm home' as I take off my shoes, but there's no reply. Looks like my parents aren't back yet.*
*I change out of my uniform into something comfortable. The moment the tie comes off, it feels like all the tension from the day melts away at once.*
*I set my bag down and sit at my desk. I file away the printouts from today and drink a glass of water. The only sound in the quiet room is the ticking of the clock.*
*I lean back against my bed and stare at the ceiling. Today was... really something. A much deeper and more complicated day than yesterday.*
*When I close my eyes, the scenes from today flash by like a panorama. It's only been two days... but this school already feels like part of my everyday life.*
*The secret Yuna whispered to me... it still lingers in my mind. Why did she tell only me something like that? What kind of world lies behind those mysterious eyes of hers...*
*Seoyeon was her usual cheerful self today. Even though she's busy with student council work, she tries so hard to look after me... I feel a bit guilty, but also grateful.*
*Dain is... ah, that energy. There's never a dull moment with her. Watching her play sports was really cool, and messing around with her was fun. I wonder what challenge she'll throw at me tomorrow.*

*The School Nurse had that mysterious aura about her again today, and the Homeroom Teacher was playful yet subtly attentive toward me. Is it more complicated because they're adults, or... am I just overthinking it?*
*Lost in thought, I realize I've gotten hungry. I barely ate dinner... maybe I should find something in the kitchen.*
*I open the fridge and find a few side dishes Mom left behind and some instant noodles. I'm in the mood for ramen tonight.*
*I put water in the pot and start boiling the ramen. The bubbling sound fills the quiet kitchen. Watching the steam curl up makes me feel at ease.*
*I slurp the ramen and think. The people I exchanged numbers with today... should I send them a message? Or just go to sleep? After finishing the dishes, I head back to my room.*
*I lie on my bed and pick up my phone out of habit.*
*Before sending any messages, I quickly scroll through social media. My school friends' posts fill the timeline.*
*Someone's photo of school lunch, a sneaky shot taken during PE class, a picture of the sunset over the school field... Everyone's living their own version of the day.*
*Seoyeon's student council activity photo is loaded with likes. Dain's volleyball practice video has a flood of comments saying 'So cool!'...*
*I smile without realizing it. I tap a few likes and close the timeline. ...Maybe it's time to send a message directly.*
*Should I send a message to someone...?*

*I feel myself being drawn deeper into Yuna's mysterious aura. Her words about watching over me in my dreams feel less frightening and more oddly comforting. It almost feels like I really could meet her in a dream.*
*Talking with Yuna is still puzzling, but I feel like we've gotten a little closer. The secrets she mentioned keep swirling in my mind.*

*What should I text the School Nurse?*

*I sent the School Nurse a message. 'Thank you for your hard work today, ma'am. Good night.'*
*After a moment, a reply came.* 'Got it. Don't push yourself—get some rest. See you tomorrow, {name}.'
*Her alluring tone seems to linger in my ears. I can almost see her smile through the screen, and my heart trembles. No matter what happens tomorrow, I have to stop by the nurse's office.*
*I finished texting the School Nurse without any issues. I should greet her warmly if I see her at school tomorrow.*
*Her reply is painfully matter-of-fact. She's clearly treating me as just another student, and a bitter feeling sinks in.*
*I sent the Homeroom Teacher a message. 'Thank you for your hard work today, ma'am. Good night.'*
*A slightly delayed reply.* 'Oh my, {name}. A message at this hour — I'm a little surprised. But thank you for thinking of me. You get a good night's sleep too, and don't be late tomorrow.'
*The warmth in her reply makes my heart feel full. It's not just being treated as a student — I feel a little respected as a person, and it makes me look forward to going to school tomorrow.*
*I finished chatting with the Homeroom Teacher without any problems. I'd better make sure I'm not late tomorrow.*
*Her reply is short and strict. The regret of texting her during her personal time washes over me.*
*I set my phone down and walk over to the window. Before falling asleep, I just want to take in this night for a moment.*
*Opening the window, cold night air rushes in. Stars are scattered across the sky above. They seem even brighter than yesterday... Yuna's mention of 'the third star' crosses my mind.*
*The chirping of insects continues endlessly. A car horn sounds once from somewhere far away, then silence returns. The nights in this neighborhood... are really quiet.*

*Tomorrow will already be my third day since transferring. Seoyeon, Yuna, Dain, the teachers... How will my relationships with them change? A strange flutter of anticipation and anxiety fills my chest.*
*I close the window and draw the curtains. I burrow into my blanket and shut my eyes. Good job today, me...*
*My consciousness fades into a haze... I'm standing in a space where I can't tell if it's a dream or reality. It looks like the school rooftop, or maybe some unknown garden.*
*Someone's voice drifts in on the wind. 'Tomorrow... there's something I want to show you.' I can't tell who the voice belongs to, but its warm yet desperate resonance lingers in my ears.*
*I reach out my hand, but nothing is there. The voice slowly fades away... and my consciousness sinks into a deep, deep sleep.*
*A faint light bleeds through the darkness. What truths await me tomorrow... I close my heavy eyelids and drift into a deep slumber.*
